_comment: Xen Orchestra CPF settings. Every leaf is {value, default, description}; only value is read. Host and API token come from RAS provider/connect and never belong here.

connection._comment: XO REST transport. Host and API token come from RAS custom settings.

request_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for an XO REST request. Range: 5-300.

skip_tls_default.description: Keep false outside an isolated lab.

capabilities._comment: Values advertised to RAS by provider/initialize.

guests_polling_rate.description: Seconds between RAS inventory polls. Range: 5-600.

template_method.description: CPF template workflow. basic uses REST cloning. versioning resolves the exact RAS snapshot through REST and clones it through XO JSON-RPC vm.clone. Allowed: basic, versioning.

inventory._comment: VMs and templates returned to RAS.

include_templates.description: Include user templates in RAS inventory.

name_filter.description: Optional PowerShell wildcard applied to VM names.

logging._comment: Diagnostics go to a file; CPF stdout remains JSON only.

log_file.description: Relative paths resolve beside the provider.

log_level.description: standard = lifecycle/errors; extended = per-operation route, status and timing; debug = sanitized request/response details. Allowed: standard, extended, debug.

log_rotate_max_mb.description: Rotate the log when it reaches this size in MiB. Range: 1-2048.

log_rotate_max_generations.description: Rotated generations retained as .1, .2, etc. Range: 1-20.
